description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePictureDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It handles data access operations for employee pictures, such as saving and retrieving employee picture entities from the database.

classes.name: EmployeePictureDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for employee picture entities, providing methods to save and fetch employee pictures by employee number.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Persists an EmpPicture entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpPicture entity by employee number, returning null if not found.
